name: PAMAP2: Physical Activity Monitoring Dataset
description: The PAMAP2 Physical Activity Monitoring dataset contains sensor data of 18 different physical activities (such as walking, cycling, Nordic walking, running, and climbing stairs) performed by 9 subjects wearing 3 inertial measurement units (IMUs) over chest, wrist, and ankle, alongside a heart rate monitor.
